blocks.content: Thus, transition elements such as (39) are important insofar as $F$ may arise in some way from a change $\delta S$ in an action expression. We denote, by observable functionals, those functionals $F$ which can be defined, (possibly indirectly) in terms of the changes which are produced by possible changes in the action $S$. The condition that a functional be observable is somewhat similar to the condition that an operator be Hermitian.
